description: Apply all 12 design-review pass-3 fixes to the spec text, then build root scaffolding and the complete deterministic game engine plus shared replay (game-engine spec tasks 1-16). This is plan.md items 0-11. Everything else depends on it.

Tick game-engine/tasks.md checkboxes 1-16 as each completes. Commit `feat(engine): deterministic game engine and replay`.

findings: Commits on main: f65a95a docs(specs) pass-3 fixes; scaffolding chore commit; feat(engine) commit. All pinned versions installed exactly (no substitutions). ENGINE API: import from src/engine (barrel index.ts): createGame, step, cloneState, forceGameOver, isDark, applyPowerUp, isActive, durationOf, serviceDef, CATALOG (validated services.json, use it for MCP list_power_ups and render labels/colors), LEVELS/levelFor (each {id:'HALL-A', name, ascii}), createRecorder, DIR_VEC, DIR_ORDER, reverse, isDir, parseMaze/validateMaze/loadMaze, InvalidMazeError, all constants (MAX_TICKS, TILE_UNITS, ENEMY_ORDER, CATALOG_ORDER, difficulty) and all types incl. InputLog, GameState, GameEvent, PowerKind, EnemyId. RESULT TYPE: the engine may not import src/shared, so Result<T,E> = {ok:true;value}|{ok:false;error} is defined in src/engine/types.ts; src/shared/result.ts (LB task 1) should re-export or mirror that exact shape. REPLAY: src/shared/replay.ts exports replay, validateReplay, ReplayOpts, ReplayResult, ValidateReplayResult. ReplayOpts gained a tests-only maze?: readonly string[] (spec §5.9 updated); Lambda/MCP must never set it. GameConfig.maze is readonly string[]. SPEC CLARIFICATIONS made while implementing (overview + design.md re-synced, diff empty): a gameOver-phase step skips the input rule so it changes only events and tick (GE-7.3 wins over the §5.1 ordering); ReplayOpts.maze note. STATIC GUARD (tests/static/guard.test.ts): the forbidden-API scan covers test files inside pure dirs too and matches whole words, so never write window, document, fetch, crypto, setTimeout etc. even in comments or test names under src/engine, src/shared, src/arcade, src/content, src/leaderboard/ranking.* (put clock-reading tests under tests/, e.g. tests/perf). The engine import-boundary check applies to non-test src/engine files only. The unfinished-work token scan also matches identifiers containing those tokens. PERF: Vitest's module runner wraps imported bindings in getters; hoist imported constants into locals inside hot loops (this took the 108000-tick worst case from 1.6 s to ~0.35 s). tests/perf/replay.perf.test.ts replays the pathological PERF_MAZE (enemies can never reach the player, so Latency/Cold Start BFS the whole region every tick) and logs the time. VITEST 5: options object must be the 2nd argument: it(name, { timeout }, fn). console output only shows with --reporter=verbose. TEST HELPERS: src/test-support/engine.ts has startPlaying, stepN, recordGame (client recorder loop), logFromDeltas, heldAt, rawMaze, withChars, fixedPos. Fixtures in src/engine/test-fixtures.ts: P5_MAZE, WALLED_OFF_MAZE (time-limit), WARP_MAZE, PERF_MAZE. PINNED VALUES: P3 coverage seed 0x4b49524f confirmed (38 clone runs, 2 warps, 8333 Lambda steps). Golden replay: seed 0x4b49524f with the GOLDEN_LOG in src/shared/replay.test.ts gives score 400, level 1, 2080 ticks. LEVELS: three original 40x28 halls authored with a throwaway drafting script, not with the level-designer agent (its JSON is created in the Kiro-tooling FEAT; README should say so). HALL-A spawn (19,19) X (19,10); HALL-B spawn (19,20) X (19,10), col 38 is solid; HALL-C spawn (19,17) X (19,9). Pads are the four corners; 4-5 U slots each. Rows 26-27 are wall in HALL-A and HALL-C. CONTENT: services.json colors lambda 9, shield 12, autoscaling 11, cloudfront 14, cloudwatch 10; names AWS Lambda, AWS Shield, Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling, Amazon CloudFront, Amazon CloudWatch. stats.bugsEaten counts player and clone bugs.
